verdict.line: You lose if you let him stack Acquired Taste and out-trade you in extended melee; you win if you poke with Q from range, deny easy stacks, and punish him with Feast once level 6 hits.

brief.thesis: Tahm's passive, An Acquired Taste, scales his damage off his own total health, so every point of tankiness he buys makes him hit harder, and his Q (Tongue Lash, 900 range) matches your poke range while building toward a stun. Extended trades reward him; short poke-and-reset exchanges don't. The 48.3% win rate over 174 games reflects a lane you have to play patiently, not one you can brawl through.

theirWindow.what: His next Q (Tongue Lash) stuns instead of just slowing, and he can use Devour (R) on you directly for magic burst. Back off and let minions eat the next poke rather than contest the wave.

yourWindow.when: after level 6, he overextends low on HP
yourWindow.what: R (Feast) deals high true damage at 175 range and grows you a permanent max-health stack if it kills — all-in when he's below that execute threshold and can't reach his escape.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The sustain and mana keep you throwing Q (Rupture) and W (Feral Scream) from range without running dry, which is how this matchup is actually won — chosen 71.3% of the time for 46% wins.

boots.why: Every one of Tahm's damaging abilities — Q, W, R — is magic damage; the flat MR mitigates all of them, and the tenacity softens his Q slows.

core.why: Converts the health you're already stacking via trades into permanent bulk, which directly counters his health-scaled passive instead of feeding it.
Sustain and AOE burn let you win extended skirmishes once you're ahead on items rather than relying on raw burst.
Punishes his Thick Skin sustain and his passive's attack-based damage with grievous wounds and reflected damage.

situational.when: he's snowballing off early trades and you need omnivamp to stay in lane
you want to force kills with mobility and burst instead of grinding a tank path
you're ahead and want true damage to punish his stacked health instead of pure mitigation

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs off your Q and E poke, turning safe trades into permanent health growth that stacks with Heartsteel and directly offsets his health-scaled passive damage.

summoners.why: Teleport (72.1% pick, 50% win) fits the patient, poke-and-reset shape of this lane and lets you leave to help sidelane once you've denied him easy stacks. Ignite is the alternative if you want to punish his Devour window with lethal pressure instead of playing for scaling.

playing.title: Open every trade with Q
playing.detail: Lead with Rupture (9s cd, 950 range) to slow and knock him up from outside his melee range. Never walk in to start a fight with Vorpal Spikes.

playing.title: Track his stack count, not just his HP
playing.detail: Every Tongue Lash he lands adds a stack of Acquired Taste. At 3, his next Q stuns and he can Devour you for burst — disengage before he caps it.

playing.title: Hold W for his dive, don't farm with it
playing.detail: Feral Scream (13s cd, 300 range cone silence) is best saved to shut down his follow-up after Abyssal Dive lands, not spent clearing waves.

playing.title: Feast minions and monsters to pre-stack
playing.detail: R (Feast) kills any enemy unit it finishes, not just champions — use it on cannon minions or jungle monsters to bank stacks before you need the execute on him.

playing.title: Don't commit expecting to out-damage his shield
playing.detail: Thick Skin stores incoming damage while he's out of combat and converts it into a shield on demand; a long trade you think you're winning can get blunted instantly.

playing.title: Play for the level 6-8 window
playing.detail: This is where Feast's execute threat forces him to respect you for the first time — use it to contest lane control rather than before.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (174 matches for this exact matchup). The ability mechanics, cooldown reasoning, and power-curve timing are my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being chased by his (Q) during early game. Use your ranged abilities to farm and contest lane and try to gain lane control upon reaching level 6.
